accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile — must be in S1_Active status.
ZH: Creator 档案——必须处于 S1_Active 状态。

accounts.name: s1_user_position
docs: EN: Virtual S1 position PDA for this user × creator pair.
ZH: 该用户×创作者的虚拟 S1 仓位 PDA。

accounts.name: user_spump_ata
docs: EN: User's SPUMP Token-2022 ATA — tokens will be burned from here.
ZH: 用户的 SPUMP Token-2022 关联代币账户——代币将从此处销毁。

accounts.name: spump_mint
docs: EN: Token-2022 SPUMP mint — must be mutable for burn to decrement supply.
ZH: Token-2022 SPUMP mint——必须可变才能在销毁时减少供应。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal being claimed against. Resolved Track 2 claims require settlement first;
expired unfunded proposals can refund principal directly.
ZH: 要领取的提案。已决议的 Track2 必须先完成结算；
已过期但未注资的提案可直接退还本金。

accounts.name: endorsement_position
docs: EN: User endorsement position PDA — tracks staked amount and claim status.
ZH: 用户背书仓位 PDA——追踪质押金额和领取状态。

accounts.name: user_spump_ata
docs: EN: User SPUMP ATA — receives minted SPUMP principal/refund (Token-2022).
ZH: 用户 SPUMP 关联代币账户——接收铸造返还的 SPUMP 本金（Token-2022）。

accounts.name: spump_mint
docs: EN: Token-2022 SPUMP mint — protocol_config PDA is its mint authority.
ZH: Token-2022 SPUMP mint——protocol_config PDA 是其铸造权限。

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: EN: User USDC ATA — receives Track 2 success rewards.
ZH: 用户 USDC 关联代币账户——接收 Track2 成功奖励。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal USDC vault PDA — holds the Track 2 fan pool after settlement.
ZH: 提案 USDC 金库 PDA——结算后持有 Track2 粉丝池。

accounts.name: creator
docs: EN: Creator signing the proposal terms and authorizing the on-chain launch.
ZH: 创作者签署提案条款并授权链上发起。

accounts.name: payer
docs: EN: External payer funding rent for proposal state and vault creation.
ZH: 外部付款人，为提案状态账户和金库账户支付租金。

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: EN: Global protocol configuration containing canonical SPUMP/USDC mint addresses.
ZH: 全局协议配置，包含 SPUMP/USDC 的 mint 地址。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile PDA. Must belong to `creator` and have level >= 2.
ZH: Creator 档案 PDA，必须属于 `creator` 且等级 >= 2。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal state PDA, seeded by [creator, deadline, nonce].
ZH: 提案状态 PDA，种子为 [创作者, 截止时间, nonce]。

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal-owned USDC vault PDA. Holds Track 1/2/3 funds.
ZH: 提案所有的 USDC 金库 PDA，存放 Track1/2/3 的全部资金。

accounts.name: admin
docs: EN: Admin signer — must match `protocol_config.admin`.
ZH: 管理员签名者——必须匹配 `protocol_config.admin`。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal-owned USDC vault PDA. Emergency void refunds this balance to sponsor when set.
ZH: 提案所有的 USDC 金库 PDA。紧急作废时将余额退还给 Sponsor。

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Sponsor USDC account to receive emergency refund.
ZH: 接收紧急退款的 Sponsor USDC 账户。

accounts.name: user
docs: EN: User staking (burning) SPUMP as an endorser.
ZH: 以 Endorser 身份质押（销毁）SPUMP 的用户。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal PDA. Must be Funded and not past deadline.
ZH: 提案 PDA，必须处于 Funded 状态且未过截止时间。

accounts.name: endorsement_position
docs: EN: Per-user endorsement position PDA on this proposal.
ZH: 该用户在此提案上的背书仓位 PDA。

accounts.name: user_spump_ata
docs: EN: User source token account holding SPUMP (Token-2022).
ZH: 用户持有 SPUMP 的来源代币账户（Token-2022）。

accounts.name: spump_mint
docs: EN: Token-2022 SPUMP mint — must match protocol config.
ZH: Token-2022 SPUMP mint——必须匹配协议配置。

accounts.name: executor
docs: EN: Temporarily restricted to oracle authority while holder counters are audited.
ZH: 在持有人计数器审计前，毕业触发暂时限制为 oracle authority。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile — must be in S1_Execution_Pending status.
ZH: Creator 档案——必须处于 S1_Execution_Pending 状态。

accounts.name: s1_buyout_state
docs: EN: S1 buyout state — must have a winning sponsor and expired rage-quit deadline.
ZH: S1 买断状态——必须有中标 Sponsor 且 rage-quit 截止已过。

accounts.name: creator_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Creator USDC ATA — receives the creator's direct buyout revenue.

accounts.name: creator_revenue_spump_ata
docs: EN: Creator SPUMP ATA — receives 50% of the virtual pool as graduation bonus.
ZH: Creator SPUMP 关联代币账户——接收虚拟池 50% 作为毕业奖金。

accounts.name: spump_mint
docs: EN: Token-2022 SPUMP mint — must be mutable for MintTo.
ZH: Token-2022 SPUMP mint——MintTo 需要可变。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile — must be in S1_Execution_Pending status.
ZH: Creator 档案——必须处于 S1_Execution_Pending 状态。

accounts.name: s1_buyout_state
docs: EN: S1 buyout state — rage-quit deadline must not have passed.
ZH: S1 买断状态——rage-quit 截止时间必须尚未到达。

accounts.name: s1_user_position
docs: EN: User's S1 virtual position PDA.
ZH: 用户的 S1 虚拟仓位 PDA。

accounts.name: user_spump_ata
docs: EN: User SPUMP ATA — receives the full gross return (zero tax).
ZH: 用户 SPUMP 关联代币账户——接收全额毛回报（零税率）。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile — must be in S1_Active status.
ZH: Creator 档案——必须处于 S1_Active 状态。

accounts.name: s1_user_position
docs: EN: User's S1 virtual position PDA.
ZH: 用户的 S1 虚拟仓位 PDA。

accounts.name: user_spump_ata
docs: EN: User SPUMP ATA — receives the net minted SPUMP.
ZH: 用户 SPUMP 关联代币账户——接收净铸造的 SPUMP。

accounts.name: creator_revenue_spump_ata
docs: EN: Creator SPUMP ATA — receives 50% of the exit tax as revenue.
ZH: Creator SPUMP 关联代币账户——接收退出税的 50% 作为收入。

accounts.name: spump_mint
docs: EN: Token-2022 SPUMP mint — protocol_config PDA is its mint authority.
ZH: Token-2022 SPUMP mint——protocol_config PDA 是其铸造权限。

accounts.name: oracle
docs: EN: Oracle signer. Must match protocol-configured oracle authority.
ZH: 预言机签名者，必须匹配协议配置中的 oracle_authority。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal account. Track1 base claim is valid on funded/resolved proposals,
but not on open/cancelled/voided states.
ZH: 提案账户。Track1 保底可在 funded/resolved 状态领取，
但 open/cancelled/voided 不允许。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal-owned USDC vault.
ZH: 提案拥有的 USDC 金库。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile used to verify payout destination.
ZH: Creator 档案，用于校验收款地址。

accounts.name: creator_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Creator USDC ATA receiving fixed base pay.
ZH: 接收固定保底的 Creator USDC ATA。

accounts.name: oracle
docs: EN: Oracle authority signer — must match `protocol_config.oracle_authority`.
ZH: 预言机授权签名者——必须匹配 `protocol_config.oracle_authority`。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: The proposal being settled. Must be funded and not yet resolved.
ZH: 要结算的提案。必须为 Funded 且尚未完成 Track2 结算。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal-owned USDC vault PDA.
ZH: 提案拥有的 USDC 金库 PDA。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile used to validate payout destination.
ZH: Creator 档案，用于校验收款地址。

accounts.name: creator_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Creator USDC ATA receiving Track2 creator payout.
ZH: 接收 Track2 Creator 分成的 USDC ATA。

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Sponsor USDC ATA receiving refunds.
ZH: 接收退款的 Sponsor USDC ATA。

accounts.name: oracle
docs: EN: Oracle authority signer — must match protocol config.
ZH: 预言机授权签名者——必须匹配协议配置。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal account; must be funded/resolved and not cancelled/voided.
ZH: 提案账户；必须是 funded/resolved，且不能是 cancelled/voided。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal USDC vault PDA.
ZH: 提案 USDC 金库 PDA。

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: EN: Creator profile used to validate payout destination.
ZH: Creator 档案，用于校验收款地址。

accounts.name: creator_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Creator USDC ATA receiving approved CPS payout.
ZH: 接收 CPS 佣金的 Creator USDC ATA。

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Sponsor USDC ATA receiving unused budget refund.
ZH: 接收未使用预算退款的 Sponsor USDC ATA。

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: EN: Sponsor paying USDC funding for this proposal.
ZH: 为此提案提供 USDC 资金的 Sponsor。

accounts.name: proposal
docs: EN: Proposal to fund. Can only transition from Open → Funded once.
ZH: 要注资的提案，只允许从 Open → Funded 转换一次。

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc_ata
docs: EN: Sponsor source USDC token account.
ZH: Sponsor 的 USDC 来源代币账户。

accounts.name: proposal_usdc_vault
docs: EN: Proposal-owned USDC vault PDA.
ZH: 提案所有的 USDC 金库 PDA。

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle authority signer.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Global config used for oracle auth and threshold checks.

accounts.name: creator_profile
docs: Target creator profile to upgrade.

accounts.name: upgrade_receipt
docs: Immutable receipt to guarantee one-time report consumption.

fields.name: amount
docs: EN: Internal S1 token amount to buy.
ZH: 要购买的 S1 内部代币数量。

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonically increasing version counter; starts at 1 for new anchors.

fields.name: content_kind
docs: EN: Content type for Xiaohongshu-like mixed notes.
ZH: 小红书式内容类型：短视频、图文轮播或混合笔记。

fields.name: content_hash
docs: EN: Canonical content-package digest. For mixed notes, hash a manifest
that includes note text hash plus ordered image/video digests.
ZH: 规范化内容包摘要。对于混合笔记，应对“文本摘要 + 有序图片/视频摘要”组成的 manifest 求哈希。

fields.name: content_anchor_pda
docs: EN: Optional on-chain content anchor PDA. If provided, it must belong to the creator.
ZH: 可选的链上内容锚点 PDA；若提供，必须属于当前创作者。

fields.name: track1_base_usdc
docs: EN: Track 1 guaranteed base payment (USDC units).
ZH: Track1 固定基础保底金额（USDC 最小单位）。

fields.name: track2_metric_type
docs: EN: Track 2 high-intent metric type (Views=0, Clicks=1, Saves=2).
ZH: Track2 高意向指标类型（播放量=0, 点击量=1, 收藏量=2）。

fields.name: track2_target_value
docs: EN: Track 2 target value for pro-rata settlement.
ZH: Track2 按比例结算目标值。

fields.name: track2_min_achievement_bps
docs: EN: Track 2 cliff in bps. Example 5000 = 50%.
ZH: Track2 Cliff 门槛（基点），例如 5000 = 50%。

fields.name: track3_delay_days
docs: EN: Track 3 CPS settlement delay in days after deadline (e.g. 45).
ZH: Track3 CPS 结算延迟天数（截止日之后，例如 45 天）。

fields.name: deadline
docs: EN: Unix timestamp after which Track 1 can be settled and no new endorsements accepted.
ZH: Unix 时间戳，超过后 Track1 可开始结算且不再接受新背书。

fields.name: nonce
docs: EN: Nonce to disambiguate proposals with the same creator and deadline.
ZH: 用于区分同一创作者和截止时间的提案的随机数。

fields.name: max_endorsement_spump
docs: EN: Maximum total SPUMP endorsement for this proposal (0 = uncapped).
ZH: 该提案的最大 SPUMP 背书总量（0 = 不限）。

fields.name: s1_supply
docs: Virtual S1 internal token supply; backing SPUMP is burned on buy.

fields.name: s1_early_cohort_supply
docs: Portion of current S1 supply bought before the configured early-cohort threshold.

fields.name: s1_eligible_holder_count
docs: Chain-maintained count of S1 positions with internal_token_balance > 0.

fields.name: s1_early_holder_count
docs: Chain-maintained count of eligible positions with any early-cohort balance.

fields.name: s1_regular_holder_count
docs: Chain-maintained count of eligible positions without early-cohort balance.

fields.name: s1_rating_bps
docs: Creator quality/momentum multiplier in basis points. 10_000 = 1.0x.

fields.name: s1_graduation_target_supply
docs: Supply target used by read models to estimate graduation/buyout progress.

fields.name: pending_s1_rating_bps
docs: Pending rating scheduled by oracle; 0 means no pending rating.

fields.name: last_rating_update_at
docs: Last oracle rating update timestamp.

fields.name: last_rating_report_digest
docs: Digest of the latest off-chain rating report.

fields.name: amount
docs: EN: SPUMP amount to burn as endorsement stake.
ZH: 作为背书质押销毁的 SPUMP 数量。

fields.name: max_endorsement_per_user_bps
docs: EN: Maximum endorsement per user as bps of proposal's max_endorsement_spump (e.g. 2000 = 20%).
ZH: 每用户背书上限，为提案 max_endorsement_spump 的基点比例（例如 2000 = 20%）。

fields.name: content_kind
docs: Xiaohongshu-like content type: short video, image set, or mixed media note.

fields.name: content_hash
docs: Canonical content-package digest. For mixed posts this should hash a manifest
that includes ordered media digests plus the note text digest.

fields.name: content_anchor
docs: Optional on-chain content anchor reference when the creator has anchored the post.

fields.name: track2_endorser_count
docs: Number of unique endorsers that ever joined Track 2.

fields.name: track2_unsettled_endorser_count
docs: Number of endorsement positions still pending post-settlement execution.

fields.name: track2_unsettled_spump
docs: Remaining SPUMP stake basis used for exact batched payout distribution.

fields.name: track2_initial_fan_pool
docs: Immutable Track 2 fan pool snapshot fixed at settlement time.

fields.name: track2_initial_spump_staked
docs: Immutable SPUMP stake snapshot fixed at settlement time.

fields.name: track2_reward_cap_usdc
docs: Immutable per-user Track2 fan reward cap snapshot fixed at settlement time.

fields.name: track2_residual_to
docs: Residual destination snapshot for remaining Track2 fan-pool USDC.

fields.name: track2_reward_model_snapshot
docs: Track2 fan reward model snapshot; v1 uses FlatEqual.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce to allow multiple proposals with the same creator and deadline.

fields.name: max_endorsement_spump
docs: Maximum total SPUMP endorsement for this proposal (0 = uncapped).

fields.name: spump_mint
docs: Token-2022 SPUMP mint (NonTransferable utility token).

fields.name: spump_mint_bump
docs: Bump for protocol mint authority PDA used to mint SPUMP refunds/rewards.

fields.name: max_endorsement_hard_ceiling
docs: Protocol-level total endorsement ceiling for proposals with max_endorsement_spump == 0.
0 means truly uncapped by explicit admin intent.

fields.name: max_endorsement_per_user_bps
docs: Maximum endorsement per user as basis points of proposal's max_endorsement_spump (e.g. 2000 = 20%).

fields.name: s1_buyout_creator_share_bps
docs: S1 buyout USDC share paid directly to the creator at graduation.

fields.name: s1_buyout_reward_model
docs: S1 discovery reward model: 0=FlatEqual, 1=EarlinessTiered, 2=StatusPrimary.

fields.name: s1_discovery_reward_cap_usdc
docs: Maximum S1 discovery reward any one backer can receive, in raw USDC units.

fields.name: s1_status_thankyou_usdc
docs: Fixed thank-you amount for StatusPrimary model, in raw USDC units.

fields.name: s1_buyout_residual_to
docs: Destination for unclaimed S1 discovery-pool residual: 0=creator, 1=sponsor.

fields.name: s1_discovery_min_hold_seconds
docs: Minimum seconds a backer must hold before qualifying for discovery reward.

fields.name: s1_discovery_claim_window_seconds
docs: Seconds after graduation before oracle/admin may sweep unclaimed discovery rewards.

fields.name: track2_reward_cap_usdc
docs: Maximum Track2 fan reward any one endorser can receive, in raw USDC units.

fields.name: track2_residual_to
docs: Destination for unclaimed Track2 fan-pool residual: 0=creator, 1=sponsor.

fields.name: amount
docs: EN: S1 internal token amount to exit.
ZH: 要退出的 S1 内部代币数量。

fields.name: creator_payout_usdc
docs: USDC paid directly to the creator when graduation executes.

fields.name: discovery_pool_usdc
docs: Total capped discovery reward pool reserved for qualified backers.

fields.name: discovery_pool_remaining
docs: Remaining discovery-pool USDC after capped, non-proportional claims.

fields.name: eligible_holder_count
docs: Remaining qualified backer count; this is a holder count, not stake/supply.

fields.name: early_holder_count
docs: Remaining qualified early-cohort holder count.

fields.name: regular_holder_count
docs: Remaining qualified regular holder count.

fields.name: reward_model_snapshot
docs: Reward model snapshotted at acceptance/graduation.

fields.name: residual_to_snapshot
docs: Residual destination snapshotted for this buyout: 0=creator, 1=sponsor.

fields.name: discovery_reward_cap_usdc_snapshot
docs: Per-user discovery reward cap snapshotted for this buyout.

fields.name: status_thankyou_usdc_snapshot
docs: StatusPrimary thank-you amount snapshotted for this buyout.

fields.name: discovery_min_hold_seconds_snapshot
docs: Minimum hold duration snapshotted for this buyout.

fields.name: creator_paid
docs: True once the creator's direct USDC payout has been transferred.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Graduation timestamp used to enforce the discovery reward claim window.

fields.name: claimable_usdc_remaining
docs: Remaining USDC claimable by S1 holders after graduation.

fields.name: claimable_s1_supply_remaining
docs: Remaining virtual S1 supply still entitled to the buyout proceeds.

fields.name: amount
docs: EN: Internal S1 token amount to sell.
ZH: 要卖出的 S1 内部代币数量。

fields.name: actual_value
docs: EN: Oracle-validated actual metric value.
ZH: 预言机确认的实际指标值。

fields.name: approved_cps_payout
docs: EN: Final approved CPS payout after return-window reconciliation.
ZH: 退换货窗口对账后的最终批准 CPS 佣金。

fields.name: track1_amount
docs: EN: Track 1 budget (fixed creator base pay).
ZH: Track1 预算（固定基础保底）。

fields.name: track2_amount
docs: EN: Track 2 budget (performance + fan pool).
ZH: Track2 预算（效果池 + 粉丝池）。

fields.name: track3_amount
docs: EN: Track 3 budget (CPS sales long-tail).
ZH: Track3 预算（CPS 长尾池）。

fields.name: new_level
docs: Target level after upgrade. Must be strictly greater than current level.

fields.name: metric_type
docs: Metric used by oracle to justify the upgrade.

fields.name: metric_value
docs: Metric value observed by oracle.

fields.name: report_id
docs: Unique report id used to prevent replay upgrades.

fields.name: report_digest
docs: Digest of off-chain report payload.

fields.name: observed_at
docs: Unix timestamp when metric snapshot was observed.
